# Compost

![Compost](https://scholzdev.github.io/tossup/img/coins/compost.png)

Tails: quota +2; once per level, Fortune coins gain +11% Heads for the run (max +55%).

- **Rarity:** Common
- **Heads chance:** 47%
- **Shop price:** 10 gold
- **Energy to flip:** 0

## Heads
Score 2 points

## Tails
Quota +2, fortune_odds

## Who can use it
- **Starts in the deck of:** none
- **Usable in coin sets from the start:** [The Seer](characters-seer)
- **Found in the shop and unlocked by buying it once:** [The Blade](characters-blade), [The Trader](characters-trader)
